fact.thing: minimum share of WGMI assets in bitcoin mining and digital power companies, a category that now includes hyperscale data centers and AI chips
fact.box: CoinShares Bitcoin Mining and Digital Power ETF (WGMI)
fact.claim: Since August 2026, WGMI must keep at least 80% of its net assets in what CoinShares calls bitcoin mining and digital power companies. Its prospectus defines that group to include bitcoin miners, hyperscale data centers, makers of semiconductors and parts for AI workloads, data-center power companies, and high-performance and quantum computing firms. So the fund is no longer a pure bitcoin-miner basket, and the fund page warns that results before the August 11, 2026 strategy change may not reflect the new mix. CoinShares does not publish one figure for the AI or chip share alone, and holdings change daily.
